verses.english: In the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, to fulfill the word of YHWH through the mouth of Jeremiah, YHWH stirred the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia. He caused a proclamation to pass throughout his kingdom, also putting it in writing:
verses.hebrew: וּבִשְׁנַת אַחַת לְכוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס לִכְלוֹת דְּבַר־יְהוָה מִפִּי יִרְמְיָה הֵעִיר יְהוָה אֶת־רוּחַ כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס וַיַּעֲבֶר־קוֹל בְּכָל־מַלְכוּתוֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּב לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: YHWH, God of heaven, has given me all the kingdoms of the earth, and He has charged me to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר כֹּרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס כֹּל מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהוּא־פָקַד עָלַי לִבְנוֹת־לוֹ בַיִת בִּירוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה׃

verses.english: Who among you belongs to any of His people? May his God be with him; let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of YHWH, God of Israel—He is the God who is in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: מִי־בָכֶם מִכָּל־עַמּוֹ יְהִי אֱלֹהָיו עִמּוֹ וְיַעַל לִירוּשָׁלִַם אֲשֶׁר בִּיהוּדָה וְיִבֶן אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Every survivor, from whatever place he resides in, is to be supported by the men of his place with silver, gold, belongings and livestock, together with the freewill offering for the house of God in Jerusalem.”
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־הַנִּשְׁאָר מִכָּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת אֲשֶׁר הוּא גָר־שָׁם יְנַשְּׂאוּהוּ אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמוֹ בְּכֶסֶף וּבְזָהָב וּבִרְכוּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָה עִם־הַנְּדָבָה לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: The heads of the ancestral houses of Judah and Benjamin, the priests and the Levites arose, with all whose spirit God had stirred to go up and build the house of YHWH in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקוּמוּ רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לִיהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם לְכֹל הֵעִיר הָאֱלֹהִים אֶת־רוּחוֹ לַעֲלוֹת לִבְנוֹת אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: All those around them strengthened their hands with silver vessels, gold, belongings, livestock and precious gifts, besides everything freely offered.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם חִזְּקוּ בִידֵיהֶם בִּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף בַּזָּהָב בָּרְכוּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָה וּבַמִּגְדָּנוֹת לְבַד עַל־כָּל־הִתְנַדֵּב׃

verses.english: King Cyrus brought out the vessels of the house of YHWH that Nebuchadnezzar had brought out of Jerusalem and placed in the house of his god.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ כּוֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִיא אֶת־כְּלֵי בֵית־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיא נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מִירוּשָׁלִַם וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּבֵית אֱלֹהָיו׃

verses.english: Cyrus king of Persia brought them out through Mithredath the treasurer, who counted them out to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.
verses.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס עַל־יַד מִתְרְדָת הַגִּזְבָּר וַיִּסְפְּרֵם לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר הַנָּשִׂיא לִיהוּדָה׃

verses.english: This was their number: thirty gold basins, a thousand silver basins, twenty-nine knives;
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה מִסְפָּרָם אֲגַרְטְלֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־כֶסֶף אָלֶף מַחֲלָפִים תִּשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: thirty gold bowls, four hundred and ten silver bowls of a second kind, and a thousand other vessels.
verses.hebrew: כְּפוֹרֵי זָהָב שְׁלֹשִׁים כְּפוֹרֵי כֶסֶף מִשְׁנִים אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת וַעֲשָׂרָה כֵּלִים אֲחֵרִים אָלֶף׃

verses.english: All the gold and silver vessels numbered five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought them all up when the exiles were brought up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־כֵּלִים לַזָּהָב וְלַכֶּסֶף חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְאַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת הַכֹּל הֶעֱלָה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר עִם הֵעָלוֹת הַגּוֹלָה מִבָּבֶל לִירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: These are the sons of the province who came up from the captivity of the exile, whom Nebuchadnezzor king of Babylon had exiled to Babylon. They returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own city,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי הַמְּדִינָה הָעֹלִים מִשְּׁבִי הַגּוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר הֶגְלָה נבוכדנצור [נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר] מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל לְבָבֶל וַיָּשׁוּבוּ לִירוּשָׁלִַם וִיהוּדָה אִישׁ לְעִירוֹ׃

verses.english: who came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum and Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־בָּאוּ עִם־זְרֻבָּבֶל יֵשׁוּעַ נְחֶמְיָה שְׂרָיָה רְעֵלָיָה מָרְדֳּכַי בִּלְשָׁן מִסְפָּר בִּגְוַי רְחוּם בַּעֲנָה מִסְפַּר אַנְשֵׁי עַם יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The sons of Parosh: two thousand one hundred and seventy-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ אַלְפַּיִם מֵאָה שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Shephatiah: three hundred and seventy-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Arah: seven hundred and seventy-five.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אָרַח שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת חֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים׃

verses.english: The sons of Pahath-moab, of the sons of Jeshua and Joab: two thousand eight hundred and twelve.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־פַחַת מוֹאָב לִבְנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ יוֹאָב אַלְפַּיִם שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The sons of Elam: one thousand two hundred and fifty-four.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Zattu: nine hundred and forty-five.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי זַתּוּא תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Zaccai: seven hundred and sixty.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי זַכָּי שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים׃

verses.english: The sons of Bani: six hundred and forty-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בָנִי שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Bebai: six hundred and twenty-three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בֵבָי שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Azgad: one thousand two hundred and twenty-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עַזְגָּד אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Adonikam: six hundred and sixty-six.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אֲדֹנִיקָם שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Bigvai: two thousand and fifty-six.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בִגְוָי אַלְפַּיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Adin: four hundred and fifty-four.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עָדִין אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Ater, of Hezekiah: ninety-eight.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אָטֵר לִיחִזְקִיָּה תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁמֹנָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Bezai: three hundred and twenty-three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בֵצָי שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Jorah: one hundred and twelve.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יוֹרָה מֵאָה וּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The sons of Hashum: two hundred and twenty-three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי חָשֻׁם מָאתַיִם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Gibbar: ninety-five.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי גִבָּר תִּשְׁעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Bethlehem: one hundred and twenty-three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי בֵית־לָחֶם מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The men of Netophah: fifty-six.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי נְטֹפָה חֲמִשִּׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The men of Anathoth: one hundred and twenty-eight.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי עֲנָתוֹת מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Azmaveth: forty-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עַזְמָוֶת אַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Kiriath-arim, Chephirah and Beeroth: seven hundred and forty-three.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי קִרְיַת עָרִים כְּפִירָה וּבְאֵרוֹת שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְאַרְבָּעִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Ramah and Geba: six hundred and twenty-one.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי הָרָמָה וָגָבַע שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָד׃

verses.english: The men of Michmas: one hundred and twenty-two.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי מִכְמָס מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The men of Bethel and Ai: two hundred and twenty-three.
verses.hebrew: אַנְשֵׁי בֵית־אֵל וְהָעָי מָאתַיִם עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Nebo: fifty-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נְבוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Magbish: one hundred and fifty-six.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי מַגְבִּישׁ מֵאָה חֲמִשִּׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of the other Elam: one thousand two hundred and fifty-four.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עֵילָם אַחֵר אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם חֲמִשִּׁים וְאַרְבָּעָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Harim: three hundred and twenty.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי חָרִם שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: The sons of Lod, Hadid and Ono: seven hundred and twenty-five.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־לֹד חָדִיד וְאוֹנוֹ שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת עֶשְׂרִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Jericho: three hundred and forty-five.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יְרֵחוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Senaah: three thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי סְנָאָה שְׁלֹשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְשֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת וּשְׁלֹשִׁים׃

verses.english: The priests: the sons of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua: nine hundred and seventy-three.
verses.hebrew: הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי יְדַעְיָה לְבֵית יֵשׁוּעַ תְּשַׁע מֵאוֹת שִׁבְעִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of Immer: one thousand and fifty-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי אִמֵּר אֶלֶף חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: The sons of Pashhur: one thousand two hundred and forty-seven.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי פַשְׁחוּר אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וְשִׁבְעָה׃

verses.english: The sons of Harim: one thousand and seventeen.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי חָרִם אֶלֶף וְשִׁבְעָה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The Levites: the sons of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the sons of Hodaviah: seventy-four.
verses.hebrew: הַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־יֵשׁוּעַ וְקַדְמִיאֵל לִבְנֵי הוֹדַוְיָה שִׁבְעִים וְאַרְבָּעָה׃

verses.english: The singers: the sons of Asaph: one hundred and twenty-eight.
verses.hebrew: הַמְשֹׁרְרִים בְּנֵי אָסָף מֵאָה עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה׃

verses.english: The sons of the gatekeepers: the sons of Shallum, the sons of Ater, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Akkub, the sons of Hatita and the sons of Shobai: one hundred and thirty-nine in all.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי הַשֹּׁעֲרִים בְּנֵי־שַׁלּוּם בְּנֵי־אָטֵר בְּנֵי־טַלְמוֹן בְּנֵי־עַקּוּב בְּנֵי חֲטִיטָא בְּנֵי שֹׁבָי הַכֹּל מֵאָה שְׁלֹשִׁים וְתִשְׁעָה׃

verses.english: The Nethinim: the sons of Ziha, the sons of Hasupha, the sons of Tabbaoth;
verses.hebrew: הַנְּתִינִים בְּנֵי־צִיחָא בְנֵי־חֲשׂוּפָא בְּנֵי טַבָּעוֹת׃

verses.english: the sons of Keros, the sons of Siaha, the sons of Padon;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־קֵרֹס בְּנֵי־סִיעֲהָא בְּנֵי פָדוֹן׃

verses.english: the sons of Lebanah, the sons of Hagabah, the sons of Akkub;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־לְבָנָה בְנֵי־חֲגָבָה בְּנֵי עַקּוּב׃

verses.english: the sons of Hagab, the sons of Shamlai, the sons of Hanan;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־חָגָב בְּנֵי־שמלי [שַׁלְמַי] בְּנֵי חָנָן׃

verses.english: the sons of Giddel, the sons of Gahar, the sons of Reaiah;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־גִדֵּל בְּנֵי־גַחַר בְּנֵי רְאָיָה׃

verses.english: the sons of Rezin, the sons of Nekoda, the sons of Gazzam;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־רְצִין בְּנֵי־נְקוֹדָא בְּנֵי גַזָּם׃

verses.english: the sons of Uzza, the sons of Paseah, the sons of Besai;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־עֻזָּא בְנֵי־פָסֵחַ בְּנֵי בֵסָי׃

verses.english: the sons of Asnah, the sons of Me'inim, the sons of Nephisim;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אַסְנָה בְנֵי־מעינים [מְעוּנִים] בְּנֵי נפיסים [נְפוּסִים׃]

verses.english: the sons of Bakbuk, the sons of Hakupha, the sons of Harhur;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־בַקְבּוּק בְּנֵי־חֲקוּפָא בְּנֵי חַרְחוּר׃

verses.english: the sons of Bazluth, the sons of Mehida, the sons of Harsha;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־בַצְלוּת בְּנֵי־מְחִידָא בְּנֵי חַרְשָׁא׃

verses.english: the sons of Barkos, the sons of Sisera, the sons of Temah;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־בַרְקוֹס בְּנֵי־סִיסְרָא בְּנֵי־תָמַח׃

verses.english: the sons of Neziah, the sons of Hatipha.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי נְצִיחַ בְּנֵי חֲטִיפָא׃

verses.english: The sons of Solomon's servants: the sons of Sotai, the sons of Hassophereth, the sons of Peruda;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה בְּנֵי־סֹטַי בְּנֵי־הַסֹּפֶרֶת בְּנֵי פְרוּדָא׃

verses.english: the sons of Jaalah, the sons of Darkon, the sons of Giddel;
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־יַעְלָה בְנֵי־דַרְקוֹן בְּנֵי גִדֵּל׃

verses.english: the sons of Shephatiah, the sons of Hattil, the sons of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the sons of Ami.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה בְנֵי־חַטִּיל בְּנֵי פֹּכֶרֶת הַצְּבָיִים בְּנֵי אָמִי׃

verses.english: All the Nethinim and the sons of Solomon's servants: three hundred and ninety-two.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַנְּתִינִים וּבְנֵי עַבְדֵי שְׁלֹמֹה שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: These came up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan and Immer, but they could not declare their ancestral house and their descent, whether they were from Israel:
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָעֹלִים מִתֵּל מֶלַח תֵּל חַרְשָׁא כְּרוּב אַדָּן אִמֵּר וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהַגִּיד בֵּית־אֲבוֹתָם וְזַרְעָם אִם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל הֵם׃

verses.english: the sons of Delaiah, the sons of Tobiah and the sons of Nekoda: six hundred and fifty-two.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי־דְלָיָה בְנֵי־טוֹבִיָּה בְּנֵי נְקוֹדָא שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת חֲמִשִּׁים וּשְׁנָיִם׃

verses.english: And from the sons of the priests: the sons of Hobaiah, the sons of Hakkoz and the sons of Barzillai, who had taken a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים בְּנֵי חֳבַיָּה בְּנֵי הַקּוֹץ בְּנֵי בַרְזִלַּי אֲשֶׁר לָקַח מִבְּנוֹת בַּרְזִלַּי הַגִּלְעָדִי אִשָּׁה וַיִּקָּרֵא עַל־שְׁמָם׃

verses.english: These sought their record among those registered by genealogy, but they were not found, and they were excluded as defiled from the priesthood.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בִּקְשׁוּ כְתָבָם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂים וְלֹא נִמְצָאוּ וַיְגֹאֲלוּ מִן־הַכְּהֻנָּה׃

verses.english: The Tirshatha told them that they must not eat from the most holy things until a priest stood up with Urim and Thummim.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁתָא לָהֶם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ מִקֹּדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים עַד עֲמֹד כֹּהֵן לְאוּרִים וּלְתֻמִּים׃

verses.english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred and sixty,
verses.hebrew: כָּל־הַקָּהָל כְּאֶחָד אַרְבַּע רִבּוֹא אַלְפַּיִם שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵאוֹת שִׁשִּׁים׃

verses.english: apart from their male and female slaves, who numbered seven thousand three hundred and thirty-seven; they also had two hundred male and female singers.
verses.hebrew: מִלְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶם וְאַמְהֹתֵיהֶם אֵלֶּה שִׁבְעַת אֲלָפִים שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁבְעָה וְלָהֶם מְשֹׁרְרִים וּמְשֹׁרְרוֹת מָאתָיִם׃

verses.english: Their horses were seven hundred and thirty-six; their mules, two hundred and forty-five;
verses.hebrew: סוּסֵיהֶם שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וְשִׁשָּׁה פִּרְדֵיהֶם מָאתַיִם אַרְבָּעִים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: their camels, four hundred and thirty-five; donkeys, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.hebrew: גְּמַלֵּיהֶם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה חֲמֹרִים שֵׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִים שְׁבַע מֵאוֹת וְעֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: Some of the heads of the ancestral houses, when they came to the house of YHWH in Jerusalem, freely offered for the house of God, to establish it on its site.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת בְּבוֹאָם לְבֵית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם הִתְנַדְּבוּ לְבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים לְהַעֲמִידוֹ עַל־מְכוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: According to their ability, they gave to the treasury for the work: sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand minas of silver, and one hundred priests' tunics.
verses.hebrew: כְּכֹחָם נָתְנוּ לְאוֹצַר הַמְּלָאכָה זָהָב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים שֵׁשׁ־רִבֹּאות וָאֶלֶף וְכֶסֶף מָנִים חֲמֵשֶׁת אֲלָפִים וְכָתְנֹת כֹּהֲנִים מֵאָה׃

verses.english: The priests, the Levites, some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers and the Nethinim settled in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וּמִן־הָעָם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים וְהַנְּתִינִים בְּעָרֵיהֶם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעָרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: The seventh month arrived while the sons of Israel were in the cities, and the people gathered as one man in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגַּע הַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל בֶּעָרִים וַיֵּאָסְפוּ הָעָם כְּאִישׁ אֶחָד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his brothers, arose and built the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings upon it as written in the law of Moses, the man of God.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו הַכֹּהֲנִים וּזְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְאֶחָיו וַיִּבְנוּ אֶת־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְהַעֲלוֹת עָלָיו עֹלוֹת כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: They established the altar on its bases, for terror from the peoples of the lands was upon them. They offered burnt offerings on it to YHWH, burnt offerings for morning and evening.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּכִינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ עַל־מְכוֹנֹתָיו כִּי בְּאֵימָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת ויעל [וַיַּעֲלוּ] עָלָיו עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה עֹלוֹת לַבֹּקֶר וְלָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: They kept the Festival of Booths as written, with burnt offerings day by day in the prescribed number, each day's requirement on its day,
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ אֶת־חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת כַּכָּתוּב וְעֹלַת יוֹם בְּיוֹם בְּמִסְפָּר כְּמִשְׁפַּט דְּבַר־יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ׃

verses.english: and afterward the continual burnt offering, those for the new moons and all the consecrated appointed times of YHWH, and for everyone who freely offered a freewill offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵיכֵן עֹלַת תָּמִיד וְלֶחֳדָשִׁים וּלְכָל־מוֹעֲדֵי יְהוָה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁים וּלְכֹל מִתְנַדֵּב נְדָבָה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: From the first day of the seventh month they began offering burnt offerings to YHWH, though the foundation of YHWH's temple had not been laid.
verses.hebrew: מִיּוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הֵחֵלּוּ לְהַעֲלוֹת עֹלוֹת לַיהוָה וְהֵיכַל יְהוָה לֹא יֻסָּד׃

verses.english: They gave silver to the stonecutters and craftsmen, and food, drink and oil to the Sidonians and Tyrians, to bring cedar timber from Lebanon to the sea at Joppa, according to the permission Cyrus king of Persia had granted them.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ־כֶסֶף לַחֹצְבִים וְלֶחָרָשִׁים וּמַאֲכָל וּמִשְׁתֶּה וָשֶׁמֶן לַצִּדֹנִים וְלַצֹּרִים לְהָבִיא עֲצֵי אֲרָזִים מִן־הַלְּבָנוֹן אֶל־יָם יָפוֹא כְּרִשְׁיוֹן כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרַס עֲלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: In the second year after their arrival at the house of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Jeshua son of Jozadak, the rest of their brothers the priests and Levites, and all who had come from captivity to Jerusalem began the work. They appointed the Levites from twenty years old and upward to supervise the work of the house of YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּבַשָּׁנָה הַשֵּׁנִית לְבוֹאָם אֶל־בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים לִירוּשָׁלִַם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִי הֵחֵלּוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וּשְׁאָר אֲחֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְכָל־הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם וַיַּעֲמִידוּ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּם מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמַעְלָה לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Jeshua, his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, stood together to supervise those doing the work in the house of God; also the sons of Henadad, their sons and their brothers the Levites.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמֹד יֵשׁוּעַ בָּנָיו וְאֶחָיו קַדְמִיאֵל וּבָנָיו בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה כְּאֶחָד לְנַצֵּחַ עַל־עֹשֵׂה הַמְּלָאכָה בְּבֵית הָאֱלֹהִים בְּנֵי חֵנָדָד בְּנֵיהֶם וַאֲחֵיהֶם הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: When the builders laid the foundation of YHWH's temple, they stationed the priests in their vestments with trumpets, and the Levites, sons of Asaph, with cymbals, to praise YHWH according to the directions of David king of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְיִסְּדוּ הַבֹּנִים אֶת־הֵיכַל יְהוָה וַיַּעֲמִידוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים מְלֻבָּשִׁים בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְהַלְוִיִּם בְּנֵי־אָסָף בַּמְצִלְתַּיִם לְהַלֵּל אֶת־יְהוָה עַל־יְדֵי דָּוִיד מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They sang responsively in praise and thanksgiving to YHWH: “For He is good, for His steadfast love toward Israel endures forever.” All the people raised a great shout of praise to YHWH because the foundation of the house of YHWH had been laid.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְּהַלֵּל וּבְהוֹדֹת לַיהוָה כִּי טוֹב כִּי־לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָל־הָעָם הֵרִיעוּ תְרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה בְהַלֵּל לַיהוָה עַל הוּסַד בֵּית־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Many of the priests, Levites and heads of ancestral houses—the older men who had seen the first house—wept with a loud voice when this house was founded before their eyes. Many others raised their voices with joyful shouting.
verses.hebrew: וְרַבִּים מֵהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְרָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת הַזְּקֵנִים אֲשֶׁר רָאוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת הָרִאשׁוֹן בְּיָסְדוֹ זֶה הַבַּיִת בְּעֵינֵיהֶם בֹּכִים בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל וְרַבִּים בִּתְרוּעָה בְשִׂמְחָה לְהָרִים קוֹל׃

verses.english: The people could not distinguish the sound of the joyful shout from the sound of the people's weeping, for the people raised a great shout, and the sound was heard far away.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵין הָעָם מַכִּירִים קוֹל תְּרוּעַת הַשִּׂמְחָה לְקוֹל בְּכִי הָעָם כִּי הָעָם מְרִיעִים תְּרוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וְהַקּוֹל נִשְׁמַע עַד־לְמֵרָחוֹק׃

verses.english: The adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the sons of the exile were building a temple for YHWH, God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ צָרֵי יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן כִּי־בְנֵי הַגּוֹלָה בּוֹנִים הֵיכָל לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They approached Zerubbabel and the heads of the ancestral houses and said to them, “Let us build with you, for like you we seek your God, and we have not been sacrificing since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assyria, who brought us up here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְּשׁוּ אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶל וְאֶל־רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת וַיֹּאמְרוּ לָהֶם נִבְנֶה עִמָּכֶם כִּי כָכֶם נִדְרוֹשׁ לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם ולא [וְלוֹ ] אֲנַחְנוּ זֹבְחִים מִימֵי אֵסַר חַדֹּן מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר הַמַּעֲלֶה אֹתָנוּ פֹּה׃

verses.english: Zerubbabel, Jeshua and the rest of the heads of Israel's ancestral houses said to them, “It is not for you and us to build a house for our God. We ourselves together will build for YHWH, God of Israel, as King Cyrus king of Persia commanded us.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶם זְרֻבָּבֶל וְיֵשׁוּעַ וּשְׁאָר רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־לָכֶם וָלָנוּ לִבְנוֹת בַּיִת לֵאלֹהֵינוּ כִּי אֲנַחְנוּ יַחַד נִבְנֶה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוָּנוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרָס׃

verses.english: The people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah and frightened them away from building.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עַם־הָאָרֶץ מְרַפִּים יְדֵי עַם־יְהוּדָה ומבלהים [וּמְבַהֲלִים] אוֹתָם לִבְנוֹת׃

verses.english: They hired advisers against them to frustrate their plan throughout all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, until the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.hebrew: וְסֹכְרִים עֲלֵיהֶם יוֹעֲצִים לְהָפֵר עֲצָתָם כָּל־יְמֵי כּוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס וְעַד־מַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרָס׃

verses.english: In the reign of Ahasuerus, at the beginning of his reign, they wrote an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וּבְמַלְכוּת אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ בִּתְחִלַּת מַלְכוּתוֹ כָּתְבוּ שִׂטְנָה עַל־יֹשְׁבֵי יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel and the rest of his associates wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia. The document's writing was in Aramaic, and it was rendered in Aramaic.
verses.hebrew: וּבִימֵי אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתָּא כָּתַב בִּשְׁלָם מִתְרְדָת טָבְאֵל וּשְׁאָר כנותו [כְּנָוֺתָיו] עַל־ארתחששתא [אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּ] מֶלֶךְ פָּרָס וּכְתָב הַנִּשְׁתְּוָן כָּתוּב אֲרָמִית וּמְתֻרְגָּם אֲרָמִית׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Rehum the official and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter about Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king, as follows:
verses.hebrew: רְחוּם בְּעֵל־טְעֵם וְשִׁמְשַׁי סָפְרָא כְּתַבוּ אִגְּרָה חֲדָה עַל־יְרוּשְׁלֶם לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מַלְכָּא כְּנֵמָא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then Rehum the official, Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their associates—the Dinaites, Apharsathkites, Tarpelites, Apharsites, Archevites, Babylonians, Shushanchites, Dehavites and Elamites,
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן רְחוּם בְּעֵל־טְעֵם וְשִׁמְשַׁי סָפְרָא וּשְׁאָר כְּנָוָתְהוֹן דִּינָיֵא וַאֲפַרְסַתְכָיֵא טַרְפְּלָיֵא אֲפָרְסָיֵא ארכוי [אַרְכְּוָיֵא] בָבְלָיֵא שׁוּשַׁנְכָיֵא דהוא [דֶּהָיֵא] עֵלְמָיֵא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] and the rest of the nations whom the great and honored Osnappar had exiled and settled in the city of Samaria and in the rest of Beyond the River. And now:
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁאָר אֻמַּיָּא דִּי הַגְלִי אָסְנַפַּר רַבָּא וְיַקִּירָא וְהוֹתֵב הִמּוֹ בְּקִרְיָה דִּי שָׁמְרָיִן וּשְׁאָר עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּכְעֶנֶת׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] This is the copy of the letter they sent him: “To Artaxerxes the king: your servants, the men of Beyond the River. And now:
verses.hebrew: דְּנָה פַּרְשֶׁגֶן אִגַּרְתָּא דִּי שְׁלַחוּ עֲלוֹהִי עַל־אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מַלְכָּא עַבְדָיךְ אֱנָשׁ עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּכְעֶנֶת׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Let it be known to the king that the Jews who came up from you have come to us at Jerusalem. They are building the rebellious and wicked city; they have completed its walls and are repairing its foundations.
verses.hebrew: יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לְמַלְכָּא דִּי יְהוּדָיֵא דִּי סְלִקוּ מִן־לְוָתָךְ עֲלֶינָא אֲתוֹ לִירוּשְׁלֶם קִרְיְתָא מָרָדְתָּא ובאישתא [וּבִישְׁתָּא] בָּנַיִן ושורי [וְשׁוּרַיָּא] אשכללו [שַׁכְלִילוּ] וְאֻשַּׁיָּא יַחִיטוּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Now let it be known to the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls completed, they will not pay tribute, tax or toll, and it will damage royal revenue.
verses.hebrew: כְּעַן יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לְמַלְכָּא דִּי הֵן קִרְיְתָא דָךְ תִּתְבְּנֵא וְשׁוּרַיָּה יִשְׁתַּכְלְלוּן מִנְדָּה־בְלוֹ וַהֲלָךְ לָא יִנְתְּנוּן וְאַפְּתֹם מַלְכִים תְּהַנְזִק׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Now, because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not fitting for us to see the king's dishonor, we have sent and informed the king,
verses.hebrew: כְּעַן כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי־מְלַח הֵיכְלָא מְלַחְנָא וְעַרְוַת מַלְכָּא לָא אֲ‍רִיךְ לַנָא לְמֶחֱזֵא עַל־דְּנָה שְׁלַחְנָא וְהוֹדַעְנָא לְמַלְכָּא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] so that a search may be made in the record book of your fathers. You will find in the record book and know that this city is rebellious and harmful to kings and provinces, and that revolt has been carried on within it from ancient days. For this reason the city was destroyed.
verses.hebrew: דִּי יְבַקַּר בִּסְפַר־דָּכְרָנַיָּא דִּי אֲבָהָתָךְ וּתְהַשְׁכַּח בִּסְפַר דָּכְרָנַיָּא וְתִנְדַּע דִּי קִרְיְתָא דָךְ קִרְיָא מָרָדָא וּמְהַנְזְקַת מַלְכִין וּמְדִנָן וְאֶשְׁתַּדּוּר עָבְדִין בְּגַוַּהּ מִן־יוֹמָת עָלְמָא עַל־דְּנָה קִרְיְתָא דָךְ הָחָרְבַת׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] We inform the king that if this city is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will consequently have no portion in Beyond the River.”
verses.hebrew: מְהוֹדְעִין אֲנַחְנָה לְמַלְכָּא דִּי הֵן קִרְיְתָא דָךְ תִּתְבְּנֵא וְשׁוּרַיָּה יִשְׁתַּכְלְלוּן לָקֳבֵל דְּנָה חֲלָק בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָא לָא אִיתַי לָךְ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] The king sent a reply to Rehum the official, Shimshai the scribe and the rest of their associates who lived in Samaria and the rest of Beyond the River: “Peace. And now:
verses.hebrew: פִּתְגָמָא שְׁלַח מַלְכָּא עַל־רְחוּם בְּעֵל־טְעֵם וְשִׁמְשַׁי סָפְרָא וּשְׁאָר כְּנָוָתְהוֹן דִּי יָתְבִין בְּשָׁמְרָיִן וּשְׁאָר עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה שְׁלָם וּכְעֶת׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] The document you sent to us has been read clearly before me.
verses.hebrew: נִשְׁתְּוָנָא דִּי שְׁלַחְתּוּן עֲלֶינָא מְפָרַשׁ קֱרִי קָדָמָי׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] I issued an order, and a search was made. They found that this city has risen against kings from ancient days, and rebellion and revolt have been carried on within it.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם וּבַקַּרוּ וְהַשְׁכַּחוּ דִּי קִרְיְתָא דָךְ מִן־יוֹמָת עָלְמָא עַל־מַלְכִין מִתְנַשְּׂאָה וּמְרַד וְאֶשְׁתַּדּוּר מִתְעֲבֶד־בַּהּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Mighty kings have ruled over Jerusalem and exercised power over all Beyond the River, and tribute, tax and toll were paid to them.
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכִין תַּקִּיפִין הֲווֹ עַל־יְרוּשְׁלֶם וְשַׁלִּיטִין בְּכֹל עֲבַר נַהֲרָה וּמִדָּה בְלוֹ וַהֲלָךְ מִתְיְהֵב לְהוֹן׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Now issue an order to stop these men. This city must not be rebuilt until an order is issued by me.
verses.hebrew: כְּעַן שִׂימוּ טְּעֵם לְבַטָּלָא גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ וְקִרְיְתָא דָךְ לָא תִתְבְּנֵא עַד־מִנִּי טַעְמָא יִתְּשָׂם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Take care not to neglect this. Why should damage increase to the harm of kings?”
verses.hebrew: וּזְהִירִין הֱווֹ שָׁלוּ לְמֶעְבַּד עַל־דְּנָה לְמָה יִשְׂגֵּא חֲבָלָא לְהַנְזָקַת מַלְכִין׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then, as soon as the copy of King Artaxerxes' document was read before Rehum, Shimshai the scribe and their associates, they hurried to Jerusalem against the Jews and stopped them by force of arms.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן מִן־דִּי פַּרְשֶׁגֶן נִשְׁתְּוָנָא דִּי ארתחששתא [אַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּ] מַלְכָּא קֱרִי קֳדָם־רְחוּם וְשִׁמְשַׁי סָפְרָא וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן אֲזַלוּ בִבְהִילוּ לִירוּשְׁלֶם עַל־יְהוּדָיֵא וּבַטִּלוּ הִמּוֹ בְּאֶדְרָע וְחָיִל׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then the work on the house of God in Jerusalem stopped. It remained stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן בְּטֵלַת עֲבִידַת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דִּי בִּירוּשְׁלֶם וַהֲוָת בָּטְלָא עַד שְׁנַת תַּרְתֵּין לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ־פָּרָס׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo, the prophets, prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel, who was over them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְנַבִּי חַגַּי נביאה [נְבִיָּא] וּזְכַרְיָה בַר־עִדּוֹא נביאיא [נְבִיַּיָּא] עַל־יְהוּדָיֵא דִּי בִיהוּד וּבִירוּשְׁלֶם בְּשֻׁם אֱלָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלֵיהוֹן׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and Jeshua son of Jozadak arose and began to build the house of God in Jerusalem. God's prophets were with them, helping them.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן קָמוּ זְרֻבָּבֶל בַּר־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל וְיֵשׁוּעַ בַּר־יוֹצָדָק וְשָׁרִיו לְמִבְנֵא בֵּית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְעִמְּהוֹן נביאיא [נְבִיַּיָּא] דִי־אֱלָהָא מְסָעֲדִין לְהוֹן׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] At that time Tattenai, governor of Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai and their associates came to them and said, “Who issued you an order to build this house and complete this structure?”
verses.hebrew: בֵּהּ־זִמְנָא אֲתָא עֲלֵיהוֹן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן וְכֵן אָמְרִין לְהֹם מַן־שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵא וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה לְשַׁכְלָלָה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then we spoke to them as follows: “What are the names of the men building this building?”
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן כְּנֵמָא אֲמַרְנָא לְּהֹם מַן־אִנּוּן שְׁמָהָת גֻּבְרַיָּא דִּי־דְנָה בִנְיָנָא בָּנַיִן׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews, and they did not stop them until a report could go to Darius and a document could then be returned about this.
verses.hebrew: וְעֵין אֱלָהֲהֹם הֲוָת עַל־שָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא וְלָא־בַטִּלוּ הִמּוֹ עַד־טַעְמָא לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ יְהָךְ וֶאֱדַיִן יְתִיבוּן נִשְׁתְּוָנָא עַל־דְּנָה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] A copy of the letter that Tattenai, governor of Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai and his associates the Apharsachites in Beyond the River sent to Darius the king:
verses.hebrew: פַּרְשֶׁגֶן אִגַּרְתָּא דִּי־שְׁלַח תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה וּשְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתֵהּ אֲפַרְסְכָיֵא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה עַל־דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] They sent him a report, and this was written in it: “To Darius the king: all peace.
verses.hebrew: פִּתְגָמָא שְׁלַחוּ עֲלוֹהִי וְכִדְנָה כְּתִיב בְּגַוֵּהּ לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שְׁלָמָא כֹלָּא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Let it be known to the king that we went to the province of Judah, to the house of the great God. It is being built with great stones, and timber is being placed in the walls. This work is being done diligently and is prospering in their hands.
verses.hebrew: יְדִיעַ לֶהֱוֵא לְמַלְכָּא דִּי־אֲזַלְנָא לִיהוּד מְדִינְתָּא לְבֵית אֱלָהָא רַבָּא וְהוּא מִתְבְּנֵא אֶבֶן גְּלָל וְאָע מִתְּשָׂם בְּכֻתְלַיָּא וַעֲבִידְתָּא דָךְ אָסְפַּרְנָא מִתְעַבְדָא וּמַצְלַח בְּיֶדְהֹם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then we questioned these elders, saying to them, ‘Who issued you an order to build this house and complete this structure?’
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן שְׁאֵלְנָא לְשָׂבַיָּא אִלֵּךְ כְּנֵמָא אֲמַרְנָא לְּהֹם מַן־שָׂם לְכֹם טְעֵם בַּיְתָא דְנָה לְמִבְנְיָה וְאֻשַּׁרְנָא דְנָה לְשַׁכְלָלָה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] We also asked them their names to inform you, so that we could write down the names of the men at their head.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף שְׁמָהָתְהֹם שְׁאֵלְנָא לְּהֹם לְהוֹדָעוּתָךְ דִּי נִכְתֻּב שֻׁם־גֻּבְרַיָּא דִּי בְרָאשֵׁיהֹם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] They returned this answer to us: ‘We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building the house that was built many years ago. A great king of Israel built and completed it.
verses.hebrew: וּכְנֵמָא פִתְגָמָא הֲתִיבוּנָא לְמֵמַר אֲנַחְנָא הִמּוֹ עַבְדוֹהִי דִי־אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא וְאַרְעָא וּבָנַיִן בַּיְתָא דִּי־הֲוָא בְנֵה מִקַּדְמַת דְּנָה שְׁנִין שַׂגִּיאָן וּמֶלֶךְ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל רַב בְּנָהִי וְשַׁכְלְלֵהּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] But because our fathers provoked the God of heaven, He gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, the Chaldean. He demolished this house and exiled the people to Babylon.
verses.hebrew: לָהֵן מִן־דִּי הַרְגִּזוּ אֲבָהֳתַנָא לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא יְהַב הִמּוֹ בְּיַד נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶל כסדיא [כַּסְדָּאָה] וּבַיְתָה דְנָה סַתְרֵהּ וְעַמָּה הַגְלִי לְבָבֶל׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Yet in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, King Cyrus issued an order to build this house of God.
verses.hebrew: בְּרַם בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְכוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא דִּי בָבֶל כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה לִבְּנֵא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Also, the gold and silver vessels of God's house that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to the temple in Babylon—King Cyrus took them from the temple in Babylon, and they were given to a man named Sheshbazzar, whom he had appointed governor.
verses.hebrew: וְאַף מָאנַיָּא דִי־בֵית־אֱלָהָא דִּי דַהֲבָה וְכַסְפָּא דִּי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הַנְפֵּק מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְהֵיבֵל הִמּוֹ לְהֵיכְלָא דִּי בָבֶל הַנְפֵּק הִמּוֹ כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי בָבֶל וִיהִיבוּ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר שְׁמֵהּ דִּי פֶחָה שָׂמֵהּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] He said to him, ‘Take these vessels; go and deposit them in the temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be rebuilt on its site.’
verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַר־לֵהּ אלה [אֵל] מָאנַיָּא שֵׂא אֵזֶל־אֲחֵת הִמּוֹ בְּהֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וּבֵית אֱלָהָא יִתְבְּנֵא עַל־אַתְרֵהּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then this Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of the house of God in Jerusalem. From that time until now it has been under construction, but it is not finished.’
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּר דֵּךְ אֲתָא יְהַב אֻשַּׁיָּא דִּי־בֵית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וּמִן־אֱדַיִן וְעַד־כְּעַן מִתְבְּנֵא וְלָא שְׁלִם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Now, if it pleases the king, let a search be made there in Babylon, in the king's treasury house, to see whether King Cyrus issued an order to build this house of God in Jerusalem. Let the king send us his will concerning this.”
verses.hebrew: וּכְעַן הֵן עַל־מַלְכָּא טָב יִתְבַּקַּר בְּבֵית גִּנְזַיָּא דִּי־מַלְכָּא תַמָּה דִּי בְּבָבֶל הֵן אִיתַי דִּי־מִן־כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שִׂים טְעֵם לְמִבְנֵא בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ בִּירוּשְׁלֶם וּרְעוּת מַלְכָּא עַל־דְּנָה יִשְׁלַח עֲלֶינָא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then Darius the king issued an order, and they searched in the archive house where the treasures were deposited in Babylon.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם וּבַקַּרוּ בְּבֵית סִפְרַיָּא דִּי גִנְזַיָּא מְהַחֲתִין תַּמָּה בְּבָבֶל׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] A scroll was found at Achmetha, in the citadel in the province of Media, and this was written in it: “Memorandum:
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁתְּכַח בְּאַחְמְתָא בְּבִירְתָא דִּי בְּמָדַי מְדִינְתָּה מְגִלָּה חֲדָה וְכֵן־כְּתִיב בְּגַוַּהּ דִּכְרוֹנָה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] In the first year of Cyrus the king, King Cyrus issued an order concerning the house of God in Jerusalem: Let the house be rebuilt as the place where sacrifices are offered, and let its foundations be supported. Its height is to be sixty cubits and its width sixty cubits,
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְכוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כּוֹרֶשׁ מַלְכָּא שָׂם טְעֵם בֵּית־אֱלָהָא בִירוּשְׁלֶם בַּיְתָא יִתְבְּנֵא אֲתַר דִּי־דָבְחִין דִּבְחִין וְאֻשּׁוֹהִי מְסוֹבְלִין רוּמֵהּ אַמִּין שִׁתִּין פְּתָיֵהּ אַמִּין שִׁתִּין׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] with three courses of great stones and a course of new timber. The expense is to be paid from the king's house.
verses.hebrew: נִדְבָּכִין דִּי־אֶבֶן גְּלָל תְּלָתָא וְנִדְבָּךְ דִּי־אָע חֲדַת וְנִפְקְתָא מִן־בֵּית מַלְכָּא תִּתְיְהִב׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Also let the gold and silver vessels of God's house, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple in Jerusalem and brought to Babylon, be returned. Let them go to the temple in Jerusalem, each to its place, and deposit them in God's house.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַף מָאנֵי בֵית־אֱלָהָא דִּי דַהֲבָה וְכַסְפָּא דִּי נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר הַנְפֵּק מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִי־בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְהֵיבֵל לְבָבֶל יַהֲתִיבוּן וִיהָךְ לְהֵיכְלָא דִי־בִירוּשְׁלֶם לְאַתְרֵהּ וְתַחֵת בְּבֵית אֱלָהָא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] “Now Tattenai, governor of Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai and their associates the Apharsachites in Beyond the River, keep far away from there.
verses.hebrew: כְּעַן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן אֲפַרְסְכָיֵא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה רַחִיקִין הֲווֹ מִן־תַּמָּה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Leave the work on this house of God alone. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God on its site.
verses.hebrew: שְׁבֻקוּ לַעֲבִידַת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ פַּחַת יְהוּדָיֵא וּלְשָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ יִבְנוֹן עַל־אַתְרֵהּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] I have issued an order concerning what you are to do for these elders of the Jews to build this house of God: from the king's resources, from the tribute of Beyond the River, the expense is to be paid diligently to these men, so that the work does not stop.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם לְמָא דִי־תַעַבְדוּן עִם־שָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא אִלֵּךְ לְמִבְנֵא בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ וּמִנִּכְסֵי מַלְכָּא דִּי מִדַּת עֲבַר נַהֲרָה אָסְפַּרְנָא נִפְקְתָא תֶּהֱוֵא מִתְיַהֲבָא לְגֻבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ דִּי־לָא לְבַטָּלָא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Whatever is needed—young bulls, rams and lambs for burnt offerings to the God of heaven, wheat, salt, wine and oil—must be given to them day by day at the word of the priests in Jerusalem, without fail,
verses.hebrew: וּמָה חַשְׁחָן וּבְנֵי תוֹרִין וְדִכְרִין וְאִמְּרִין לַעֲלָוָן לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא חִנְטִין מְלַח חֲמַר וּמְשַׁח כְּמֵאמַר כָּהֲנַיָּא דִי־בִירוּשְׁלֶם לֶהֱוֵא מִתְיְהֵב לְהֹם יוֹם בְּיוֹם דִּי־לָא שָׁלוּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] so that they may offer pleasing offerings to the God of heaven and pray for the life of the king and his sons.
verses.hebrew: דִּי־לֶהֱוֺן מְהַקְרְבִין נִיחוֹחִין לֶאֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא וּמְצַלַּיִן לְחַיֵּי מַלְכָּא וּבְנוֹהִי׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] I have also issued an order: if anyone changes this decree, a beam is to be torn from his house, and he is to be lifted up and impaled upon it. His house is to be made a refuse heap because of this.
verses.hebrew: וּמִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם דִּי כָל־אֱנָשׁ דִּי יְהַשְׁנֵא פִּתְגָמָא דְנָה יִתְנְסַח אָע מִן־בַּיְתֵהּ וּזְקִיף יִתְמְחֵא עֲלֹהִי וּבַיְתֵהּ נְוָלוּ יִתְעֲבֵד עַל־דְּנָה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] May the God who has made His name dwell there overthrow every king and people who stretches out a hand to change this or destroy this house of God in Jerusalem. I, Darius, have issued the order; let it be carried out diligently.”
verses.hebrew: וֵאלָהָא דִּי שַׁכִּן שְׁמֵהּ תַּמָּה יְמַגַּר כָּל־מֶלֶךְ וְעַם דִּי יִשְׁלַח יְדֵהּ לְהַשְׁנָיָה לְחַבָּלָה בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דֵךְ דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם אֲנָה דָרְיָוֶשׁ שָׂמֶת טְעֵם אָסְפַּרְנָא יִתְעֲבִד׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Then Tattenai, governor of Beyond the River, Shethar-bozenai and their associates acted diligently according to what Darius the king had sent.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן תַּתְּנַי פַּחַת עֲבַר־נַהֲרָה שְׁתַר בּוֹזְנַי וּכְנָוָתְהוֹן לָקֳבֵל דִּי־שְׁלַח דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כְּנֵמָא אָסְפַּרְנָא עֲבַדוּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] The elders of the Jews built and prospered through the prophecy of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo. They built and completed it by the command of the God of Israel and by the command of Cyrus, Darius and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׂבֵי יְהוּדָיֵא בָּנַיִן וּמַצְלְחִין בִּנְבוּאַת חַגַּי נביאה [נְבִיָּא] וּזְכַרְיָה בַּר־עִדּוֹא וּבְנוֹ וְשַׁכְלִלוּ מִן־טַעַם אֱלָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִטְּעֵם כּוֹרֶשׁ וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ וְאַרְתַּחְשַׁשְׂתְּא מֶלֶךְ פָּרָס׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] This house was finished by the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king.
verses.hebrew: וְשֵׁיצִיא בַּיְתָה דְנָה עַד יוֹם תְּלָתָה לִירַח אֲדָר דִּי־הִיא שְׁנַת־שֵׁת לְמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] The sons of Israel—the priests, the Levites and the rest of the sons of the exile—celebrated the dedication of this house of God with joy.
verses.hebrew: וַעֲבַדוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כָּהֲנַיָּא וְלֵוָיֵא וּשְׁאָר בְּנֵי־גָלוּתָא חֲנֻכַּת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה בְּחֶדְוָה׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] For the dedication of this house of God they offered one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and twelve male goats as a sin offering for all Israel, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וְהַקְרִבוּ לַחֲנֻכַּת בֵּית־אֱלָהָא דְנָה תּוֹרִין מְאָה דִּכְרִין מָאתַיִן אִמְּרִין אַרְבַּע מְאָה וּצְפִירֵי עִזִּין לחטיא [לְחַטָּאָה] עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל תְּרֵי־עֲשַׂר לְמִנְיָן שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] They appointed the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their courses over the service of God in Jerusalem, as written in the book of Moses.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲקִימוּ כָהֲנַיָּא בִּפְלֻגָּתְהוֹן וְלֵוָיֵא בְּמַחְלְקָתְהוֹן עַל־עֲבִידַת אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם כִּכְתָב סְפַר מֹשֶׁה׃

verses.english: The sons of the exile kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ בְנֵי־הַגּוֹלָה אֶת־הַפָּסַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

verses.english: For the priests and Levites had purified themselves together; all of them were clean. They slaughtered the Passover for all the sons of the exile, for their brothers the priests and for themselves.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הִטַּהֲרוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם כְּאֶחָד כֻּלָּם טְהוֹרִים וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ הַפֶּסַח לְכָל־בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה וְלַאֲחֵיהֶם הַכֹּהֲנִים וְלָהֶם׃

verses.english: The sons of Israel who had returned from the exile ate it, together with everyone who had separated himself from the uncleanness of the nations of the land to join them, to seek YHWH, God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַשָּׁבִים מֵהַגּוֹלָה וְכֹל הַנִּבְדָּל מִטֻּמְאַת גּוֹיֵ־הָאָרֶץ אֲלֵהֶם לִדְרֹשׁ לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: They kept the Festival of Unleavened Bread for seven days with joy, for YHWH had made them joyful and turned the heart of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ חַג־מַצּוֹת שִׁבְעַת יָמִים בְּשִׂמְחָה כִּי שִׂמְּחָם יְהוָה וְהֵסֵב לֵב מֶלֶךְ־אַשּׁוּר עֲלֵיהֶם לְחַזֵּק יְדֵיהֶם בִּמְלֶאכֶת בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: After these events, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah,
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה בְּמַלְכוּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא מֶלֶךְ־פָּרָס עֶזְרָא בֶּן־שְׂרָיָה בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה בֶּן־חִלְקִיָּה׃

verses.english: son of Shallum, son of Zadok, son of Ahitub,
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־שַׁלּוּם בֶּן־צָדוֹק בֶּן־אֲחִיטוּב׃

verses.english: son of Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraioth,
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֲמַרְיָה בֶן־עֲזַרְיָה בֶּן־מְרָיוֹת׃

verses.english: son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki,
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־זְרַחְיָה בֶן־עֻזִּי בֶּן־בֻּקִּי׃

verses.english: son of Abishua, son of Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the chief priest—
verses.hebrew: בֶּן־אֲבִישׁוּעַ בֶּן־פִּינְחָס בֶּן־אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹן הַכֹּהֵן הָרֹאשׁ׃

verses.english: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses, which YHWH, God of Israel, had given. The king granted him everything he requested, according to the hand of YHWH his God upon him.
verses.hebrew: הוּא עֶזְרָא עָלָה מִבָּבֶל וְהוּא־סֹפֵר מָהִיר בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר־נָתַן יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּיַד־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו עָלָיו כֹּל בַּקָּשָׁתוֹ׃

verses.english: Some of the sons of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers and the Nethinim went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלוּ מִבְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמִן־הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִים וְהַנְּתִינִים אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם בִּשְׁנַת־שֶׁבַע לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: He came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַם בַּחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי הִיא שְׁנַת הַשְּׁבִיעִית לַמֶּלֶךְ׃

verses.english: On the first day of the first month he began the ascent from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.
verses.hebrew: כִּי בְּאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן הוּא יְסֻד הַמַּעֲלָה מִבָּבֶל וּבְאֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁי בָּא אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלִַם כְּיַד־אֱלֹהָיו הַטּוֹבָה עָלָיו׃

verses.english: For Ezra had set his heart to seek the law of YHWH, to do it, and to teach statute and judgment in Israel.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עֶזְרָא הֵכִין לְבָבוֹ לִדְרוֹשׁ אֶת־תּוֹרַת יְהוָה וְלַעֲשֹׂת וּלְלַמֵּד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל חֹק וּמִשְׁפָּט׃

verses.english: This is the copy of the document that King Artaxerxes gave Ezra the priest, the scribe, a scribe of the words of YHWH's commandments and His statutes for Israel:
verses.hebrew: וְזֶה פַּרְשֶׁגֶן הַנִּשְׁתְּוָן אֲשֶׁר נָתַן הַמֶּלֶךְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא לְעֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן הַסֹּפֵר סֹפֵר דִּבְרֵי מִצְוֺת־יְהוָה וְחֻקָּיו עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] “Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, scribe of the law of the God of heaven, fully qualified. And now:
verses.hebrew: אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא מֶלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא לְעֶזְרָא כָהֲנָא סָפַר דָּתָא דִּי־אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא גְּמִיר וּכְעֶנֶת׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] I have issued an order that anyone in my kingdom from the people of Israel, their priests and the Levites who freely wishes to go to Jerusalem with you may go.
verses.hebrew: מִנִּי שִׂים טְעֵם דִּי כָל־מִתְנַדַּב בְּמַלְכוּתִי מִן־עַמָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל וְכָהֲנוֹהִי וְלֵוָיֵא לִמְהָךְ לִירוּשְׁלֶם עִמָּךְ יְהָךְ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] For you are sent by the king and his seven advisers to investigate Judah and Jerusalem according to the law of your God that is in your hand,
verses.hebrew: כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי מִן־קֳדָם מַלְכָּא וְשִׁבְעַת יָעֲטֹהִי שְׁלִיחַ לְבַקָּרָא עַל־יְהוּד וְלִירוּשְׁלֶם בְּדָת אֱלָהָךְ דִּי בִידָךְ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] and to carry the silver and gold that the king and his advisers have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,
verses.hebrew: וּלְהֵיבָלָה כְּסַף וּדְהַב דִּי־מַלְכָּא וְיָעֲטוֹהִי הִתְנַדַּבוּ לֶאֱלָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם מִשְׁכְּנֵהּ׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] and all the silver and gold you find throughout the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people and priests who freely offer for the house of their God in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל כְּסַף וּדְהַב דִּי תְהַשְׁכַּח בְּכֹל מְדִינַת בָּבֶל עִם הִתְנַדָּבוּת עַמָּא וְכָהֲנַיָּא מִתְנַדְּבִין לְבֵית אֱלָהֲהֹם דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Therefore, with this silver diligently buy bulls, rams and lambs, with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־קֳבֵל דְּנָה אָסְפַּרְנָא תִקְנֵא בְּכַסְפָּא דְנָה תּוֹרִין דִּכְרִין אִמְּרִין וּמִנְחָתְהוֹן וְנִסְכֵּיהוֹן וּתְקָרֵב הִמּוֹ עַל־מַדְבְּחָה דִּי בֵּית אֱלָהֲכֹם דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Whatever seems good to you and your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, do according to the will of your God.
verses.hebrew: וּמָה דִי עליך [עֲלָךְ] וְעַל־אחיך [אֶחָךְ] יֵיטַב בִּשְׁאָר כַּסְפָּא וְדַהֲבָה לְמֶעְבַּד כִּרְעוּת אֱלָהֲכֹם תַּעַבְדוּן׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] The vessels given to you for the service of the house of your God, deliver before the God of Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וּמָאנַיָּא דִּי־מִתְיַהֲבִין לָךְ לְפָלְחָן בֵּית אֱלָהָךְ הַשְׁלֵם קֳדָם אֱלָהּ יְרוּשְׁלֶם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Whatever else your God's house needs that falls to you to supply, provide from the king's treasury house.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁאָר חַשְׁחוּת בֵּית אֱלָהָךְ דִּי יִפֶּל־לָךְ לְמִנְתַּן תִּנְתֵּן מִן־בֵּית גִּנְזֵי מַלְכָּא׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] I, Artaxerxes the king, have issued an order to all the treasurers in Beyond the River: whatever Ezra the priest, scribe of the law of the God of heaven, asks of you is to be done diligently,
verses.hebrew: וּמִנִּי אֲנָה אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא מַלְכָּא שִׂים טְעֵם לְכֹל גִּזַּבְרַיָּא דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה דִּי כָל־דִּי יִשְׁאֲלֶנְכוֹן עֶזְרָא כָהֲנָה סָפַר דָּתָא דִּי־אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא אָסְפַּרְנָא יִתְעֲבִד׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] up to one hundred talents of silver, one hundred kors of wheat, one hundred baths of wine, one hundred baths of oil, and salt without a written limit.
verses.hebrew: עַד־כְּסַף כַּכְּרִין מְאָה וְעַד־חִנְטִין כֹּרִין מְאָה וְעַד־חֲמַר בַּתִּין מְאָה וְעַד־בַּתִּין מְשַׁח מְאָה וּמְלַח דִּי־לָא כְתָב׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] Whatever the God of heaven commands is to be carried out exactly for the house of the God of heaven. Why should wrath come upon the kingdom of the king and his sons?
verses.hebrew: כָּל־דִּי מִן־טַעַם אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא יִתְעֲבֵד אַדְרַזְדָּא לְבֵית אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא דִּי־לְמָה לֶהֱוֵא קְצַף עַל־מַלְכוּת מַלְכָּא וּבְנוֹהִי׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] We also inform you that no tribute, tax or toll may be imposed on any of the priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, Nethinim or servants of this house of God.
verses.hebrew: וּלְכֹם מְהוֹדְעִין דִּי כָל־כָּהֲנַיָּא וְלֵוָיֵא זַמָּרַיָּא תָרָעַיָּא נְתִינַיָּא וּפָלְחֵי בֵּית אֱלָהָא דְנָה מִנְדָּה בְלוֹ וַהֲלָךְ לָא שַׁלִּיט לְמִרְמֵא עֲלֵיהֹם׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] You, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people in Beyond the River, all who know the laws of your God; and teach those who do not know.
verses.hebrew: וְאַנְתְּ עֶזְרָא כְּחָכְמַת אֱלָהָךְ דִּי־בִידָךְ מֶנִּי שָׁפְטִין וְדַיָּנִין דִּי־לֶהֱוֺן דאנין [דָּאיְנִין] לְכָל־עַמָּה דִּי בַּעֲבַר נַהֲרָה לְכָל־יָדְעֵי דָּתֵי אֱלָהָךְ וְדִי לָא יָדַע תְּהוֹדְעוּן׃

verses.english: [Aramaic] For anyone who does not carry out the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed diligently against him, whether death, banishment, a penalty upon property, or imprisonment.”
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־דִּי־לָא לֶהֱוֵא עָבֵד דָּתָא דִי־אֱלָהָךְ וְדָתָא דִּי מַלְכָּא אָסְפַּרְנָא דִּינָה לֶהֱוֵא מִתְעֲבֵד מִנֵּהּ הֵן לְמוֹת הֵן לשרשו [לִשְׁרֹשִׁי] הֵן־לַעֲנָשׁ נִכְסִין וְלֶאֱסוּרִין׃

verses.english: Blessed be YHWH, the God of our fathers, who put such a thing in the king's heart, to beautify the house of YHWH in Jerusalem,
verses.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר נָתַן כָּזֹאת בְּלֵב הַמֶּלֶךְ לְפָאֵר אֶת־בֵּית יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: and extended steadfast love to me before the king, his advisers and all the king's mighty officials. I took courage, according to the hand of YHWH my God upon me, and gathered leaders from Israel to go up with me.
verses.hebrew: וְעָלַי הִטָּה־חֶסֶד לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיוֹעֲצָיו וּלְכָל־שָׂרֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגִּבֹּרִים וַאֲנִי הִתְחַזַּקְתִּי כְּיַד־יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי עָלַי וָאֶקְבְּצָה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל רָאשִׁים לַעֲלוֹת עִמִּי׃

verses.english: These are the heads of their ancestral houses and their genealogical registrations who came up with me from Babylon in the reign of Artaxerxes the king:
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה רָאשֵׁי אֲבֹתֵיהֶם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂם הָעֹלִים עִמִּי בְּמַלְכוּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁסְתְּא הַמֶּלֶךְ מִבָּבֶל׃

verses.english: from the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; from the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; from the sons of David, Hattush;
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי פִינְחָס גֵּרְשֹׁם מִבְּנֵי אִיתָמָר דָּנִיֵּאל מִבְּנֵי דָוִיד חַטּוּשׁ׃

verses.english: from the sons of Shecaniah; from the sons of Parosh, Zechariah, and with him one hundred and fifty males registered by genealogy;
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ זְכַרְיָה וְעִמּוֹ הִתְיַחֵשׂ לִזְכָרִים מֵאָה וַחֲמִשִּׁים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males;
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב אֶלְיְהוֹעֵינַי בֶּן־זְרַחְיָה וְעִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel, and with him three hundred males;
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי שְׁכַנְיָה בֶּן־יַחֲזִיאֵל וְעִמּוֹ שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Adin, Ebed son of Jonathan, and with him fifty males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עָדִין עֶבֶד בֶּן־יוֹנָתָן וְעִמּוֹ חֲמִשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah son of Athaliah, and with him seventy males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עֵילָם יְשַׁעְיָה בֶּן־עֲתַלְיָה וְעִמּוֹ שִׁבְעִים הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah son of Michael, and with him eighty males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי שְׁפַטְיָה זְבַדְיָה בֶּן־מִיכָאֵל וְעִמּוֹ שְׁמֹנִים הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Joab, Obadiah son of Jehiel, and with him two hundred and eighteen males;
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי יוֹאָב עֹבַדְיָה בֶּן־יְחִיאֵל וְעִמּוֹ מָאתַיִם וּשְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah, and with him one hundred and sixty males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי שְׁלוֹמִית בֶּן־יוֹסִפְיָה וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָה וְשִׁשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Bebai, Zechariah son of Bebai, and with him twenty-eight males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בֵבַי זְכַרְיָה בֶּן־בֵּבָי וְעִמּוֹ עֶשְׂרִים וּשְׁמֹנָה הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Azgad, Johanan son of Hakkatan, and with him one hundred and ten males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עַזְגָּד יוֹחָנָן בֶּן־הַקָּטָן וְעִמּוֹ מֵאָה וַעֲשָׂרָה הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Adonikam, the last ones, whose names are these: Eliphelet, Jeiel and Shemaiah, and with them sixty males;
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי אֲדֹנִיקָם אַחֲרֹנִים וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם אֱלִיפֶלֶט יְעִיאֵל וּשְׁמַעְיָה וְעִמָּהֶם שִׁשִּׁים הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: from the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud, and with him seventy males.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בִגְוַי עוּתַי וזבוד [וְזַכּוּר] וְעִמּוֹ שִׁבְעִים הַזְּכָרִים׃

verses.english: I gathered them at the river that runs toward Ahava, and we camped there for three days. I examined the people and the priests, but found none of the sons of Levi there.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶקְבְּצֵם אֶל־הַנָּהָר הַבָּא אֶל־אַהֲוָא וַנַּחֲנֶה שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה וָאָבִינָה בָעָם וּבַכֹּהֲנִים וּמִבְּנֵי לֵוִי לֹא־מָצָאתִי שָׁם׃

verses.english: I sent for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah and Meshullam, leaders, and for Joiarib and Elnathan, men of understanding.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלְחָה לֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר לַאֲרִיאֵל לִשְׁמַעְיָה וּלְאֶלְנָתָן וּלְיָרִיב וּלְאֶלְנָתָן וּלְנָתָן וְלִזְכַרְיָה וְלִמְשֻׁלָּם רָאשִׁים וּלְיוֹיָרִיב וּלְאֶלְנָתָן מְבִינִים׃

verses.english: I directed them to Iddo, the head at the place Casiphia, and put words in their mouths to speak to Iddo and his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, to bring us ministers for the house of our God.
verses.hebrew: ואוצאה [וָאֲצַוֶּה] אוֹתָם עַל־אִדּוֹ הָרֹאשׁ בְּכָסִפְיָא הַמָּקוֹם וָאָשִׂימָה בְּפִיהֶם דְּבָרִים לְדַבֵּר אֶל־אִדּוֹ אָחִיו הנתונים [הַנְּתִינִים] בְּכָסִפְיָא הַמָּקוֹם לְהָבִיא־לָנוּ מְשָׁרְתִים לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: By the good hand of our God upon us, they brought us a man of understanding from the sons of Mahli son of Levi son of Israel, and Sherebiah with his sons and brothers, eighteen in all;
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבִיאּוּ לָנוּ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַטּוֹבָה עָלֵינוּ אִישׁ שֶׂכֶל מִבְּנֵי מַחְלִי בֶּן־לֵוִי בֶּן־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְשֵׁרֵבְיָה וּבָנָיו וְאֶחָיו שְׁמֹנָה עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah from the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty in all;
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חֲשַׁבְיָה וְאִתּוֹ יְשַׁעְיָה מִבְּנֵי מְרָרִי אֶחָיו וּבְנֵיהֶם עֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: and from the Nethinim whom David and the officials had given for the service of the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim, all designated by name.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַנְּתִינִים שֶׁנָּתַן דָּוִיד וְהַשָּׂרִים לַעֲבֹדַת הַלְוִיִּם נְתִינִים מָאתַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים כֻּלָּם נִקְּבוּ בְשֵׁמוֹת׃

verses.english: I proclaimed a fast there at the river Ahava, to humble ourselves before our God and ask Him for a straight way for ourselves, our little ones and all our belongings.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶקְרָא שָׁם צוֹם עַל־הַנָּהָר אַהֲוָא לְהִתְעַנּוֹת לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ דֶּרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָנוּ וּלְטַפֵּנוּ וּלְכָל־רְכוּשֵׁנוּ׃

verses.english: For I was ashamed to ask the king for troops and horsemen to help us against an enemy on the road, because we had told the king, “The hand of our God is for good upon all who seek Him, but His power and His anger are against all who forsake Him.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי בֹשְׁתִּי לִשְׁאוֹל מִן־הַמֶּלֶךְ חַיִל וּפָרָשִׁים לְעָזְרֵנוּ מֵאוֹיֵב בַּדָּרֶךְ כִּי־אָמַרְנוּ לַמֶּלֶךְ לֵאמֹר יַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־כָּל־מְבַקְשָׁיו לְטוֹבָה וְעֻזּוֹ וְאַפּוֹ עַל כָּל־עֹזְבָיו׃

verses.english: So we fasted and sought our God concerning this, and He answered our entreaty.
verses.hebrew: וַנָּצוּמָה וַנְּבַקְשָׁה מֵאֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־זֹאת וַיֵּעָתֵר לָנוּ׃

verses.english: I set apart twelve from the chief priests, together with Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their brothers with them,
verses.hebrew: וָאַבְדִּילָה מִשָּׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לְשֵׁרֵבְיָה חֲשַׁבְיָה וְעִמָּהֶם מֵאֲחֵיהֶם עֲשָׂרָה׃

verses.english: and weighed out to them the silver, gold and vessels, the contribution for the house of our God that the king, his advisers, his officials and all Israel present there had contributed.
verses.hebrew: ואשקולה [וָאֶשְׁקֳלָה] לָהֶם אֶת־הַכֶּסֶף וְאֶת־הַזָּהָב וְאֶת־הַכֵּלִים תְּרוּמַת בֵּית־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַהֵרִימוּ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיֹעֲצָיו וְשָׂרָיו וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַנִּמְצָאִים׃

verses.english: I weighed into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, silver vessels amounting to one hundred talents, and one hundred talents of gold,
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁקֲלָה עַל־יָדָם כֶּסֶף כִּכָּרִים שֵׁשׁ־מֵאוֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁים וּכְלֵי־כֶסֶף מֵאָה לְכִכָּרִים זָהָב מֵאָה כִכָּר׃

verses.english: twenty gold bowls worth a thousand darics, and two vessels of fine gleaming bronze, as desirable as gold.
verses.hebrew: וּכְפֹרֵי זָהָב עֶשְׂרִים לַאֲדַרְכֹנִים אָלֶף וּכְלֵי נְחֹשֶׁת מֻצְהָב טוֹבָה שְׁנַיִם חֲמוּדֹת כַּזָּהָב׃

verses.english: I said to them, “You are holy to YHWH, and the vessels are holy. The silver and gold are a freewill offering to YHWH, the God of your fathers.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם קֹדֶשׁ לַיהוָה וְהַכֵּלִים קֹדֶשׁ וְהַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב נְדָבָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: Stay alert and guard them until you weigh them before the chief priests, the Levites and the heads of Israel's ancestral houses in Jerusalem, in the chambers of YHWH's house.”
verses.hebrew: שִׁקְדוּ וְשִׁמְרוּ עַד־תִּשְׁקְלוּ לִפְנֵי שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם וְשָׂרֵי־הָאָבוֹת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בִּירוּשָׁלִָם הַלִּשְׁכוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: The priests and Levites received the weight of silver, gold and vessels, to bring them to Jerusalem, to the house of our God.
verses.hebrew: וְקִבְּלוּ הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים לְהָבִיא לִירוּשָׁלִַם לְבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃

verses.english: We set out from the river Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month to go to Jerusalem. The hand of our God was upon us, and He delivered us from the hand of an enemy and an ambusher along the way.
verses.hebrew: וַנִּסְעָה מִנְּהַר אַהֲוָא בִּשְׁנֵים עָשָׂר לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן לָלֶכֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְיַד־אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָיְתָה עָלֵינוּ וַיַּצִּילֵנוּ מִכַּף אוֹיֵב וְאוֹרֵב עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ׃

verses.english: We came to Jerusalem and stayed there for three days.
verses.hebrew: וַנָּבוֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָם וַנֵּשֶׁב שָׁם יָמִים שְׁלֹשָׁה׃

verses.english: On the fourth day the silver, gold and vessels were weighed in the house of our God into the hand of Meremoth son of Uriah the priest. With him was Eleazar son of Phinehas, and with them were the Levites Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui,
verses.hebrew: וּבַיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי נִשְׁקַל הַכֶּסֶף וְהַזָּהָב וְהַכֵּלִים בְּבֵית אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל יַד־מְרֵמוֹת בֶּן־אוּרִיָּה הַכֹּהֵן וְעִמּוֹ אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־פִּינְחָס וְעִמָּהֶם יוֹזָבָד בֶּן־יֵשׁוּעַ וְנוֹעַדְיָה בֶן־בִּנּוּי הַלְוִיִּם׃

verses.english: everything by number and by weight; the entire weight was recorded at that time.
verses.hebrew: בְּמִסְפָּר בְּמִשְׁקָל לַכֹּל וַיִּכָּתֵב כָּל־הַמִּשְׁקָל בָּעֵת הַהִיא׃

verses.english: the sons of the exile who had come from captivity offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel: twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs and twelve male goats as a sin offering—all as a burnt offering to YHWH.
verses.hebrew: הַבָּאִים מֵהַשְּׁבִי בְנֵי־הַגּוֹלָה הִקְרִיבוּ עֹלוֹת לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל פָּרִים שְׁנֵים־עָשָׂר עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵילִים תִּשְׁעִים וְשִׁשָּׁה כְּבָשִׂים שִׁבְעִים וְשִׁבְעָה צְפִירֵי חַטָּאת שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר הַכֹּל עוֹלָה לַיהוָה׃

verses.english: They delivered the king's laws to the king's satraps and the governors of Beyond the River, and they supported the people and the house of God.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶת־דָּתֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ וּפַחֲווֹת עֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וְנִשְּׂאוּ אֶת־הָעָם וְאֶת־בֵּית־הָאֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: When these things were completed, the officials approached me and said, “The people of Israel, the priests and the Levites have not separated themselves from the peoples of the lands and their abominations: the Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Jebusites, Ammonites, Moabites, Egyptians and Amorites.
verses.hebrew: וּכְכַלּוֹת אֵלֶּה נִגְּשׁוּ אֵלַי הַשָּׂרִים לֵאמֹר לֹא־נִבְדְּלוּ הָעָם יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַלְוִיִּם מֵעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶם לַכְּנַעֲנִי הַחִתִּי הַפְּרִזִּי הַיְבוּסִי הָעַמֹּנִי הַמֹּאָבִי הַמִּצְרִי וְהָאֱמֹרִי׃

verses.english: For they have taken some of their daughters as wives for themselves and their sons, and the holy seed has mingled with the peoples of the lands. The officials and deputies have taken the lead in this faithlessness.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי־נָשְׂאוּ מִבְּנֹתֵיהֶם לָהֶם וְלִבְנֵיהֶם וְהִתְעָרְבוּ זֶרַע הַקֹּדֶשׁ בְּעַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְיַד הַשָּׂרִים וְהַסְּגָנִים הָיְתָה בַּמַּעַל הַזֶּה רִאשׁוֹנָה׃

verses.english: When I heard this word, I tore my garment and cloak, pulled hair from my head and beard, and sat appalled.
verses.hebrew: וּכְשָׁמְעִי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה קָרַעְתִּי אֶת־בִּגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶמְרְטָה מִשְּׂעַר רֹאשִׁי וּזְקָנִי וָאֵשְׁבָה מְשׁוֹמֵם׃

verses.english: Everyone who trembled at the words of the God of Israel gathered to me because of the exiles' faithlessness, while I sat appalled until the evening offering.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלַי יֵאָסְפוּ כֹּל חָרֵד בְּדִבְרֵי אֱלֹהֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַל מַעַל הַגּוֹלָה וַאֲנִי יֹשֵׁב מְשׁוֹמֵם עַד לְמִנְחַת הָעָרֶב׃

verses.english: At the evening offering I rose from my self-humiliation, with my garment and cloak torn, knelt upon my knees and spread out my palms toward YHWH my God,
verses.hebrew: וּבְמִנְחַת הָעֶרֶב קַמְתִּי מִתַּעֲנִיתִי וּבְקָרְעִי בִגְדִי וּמְעִילִי וָאֶכְרְעָה עַל־בִּרְכַּי וָאֶפְרְשָׂה כַפַּי אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: and said, “My God, I am ashamed and humiliated to lift my face to You, my God, for our iniquities have multiplied above our heads and our guilt has grown to the heavens.
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמְרָה אֱלֹהַי בֹּשְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַמְתִּי לְהָרִים אֱלֹהַי פָּנַי אֵלֶיךָ כִּי עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ רָבוּ לְמַעְלָה רֹּאשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵנוּ גָדְלָה עַד לַשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: From the days of our fathers until this day we have been in great guilt. Because of our iniquities, we, our kings and our priests have been given into the hand of the kings of the lands—to the sword, captivity, plunder and shame of face—as on this day.
verses.hebrew: מִימֵי אֲבֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ בְּאַשְׁמָה גְדֹלָה עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וּבַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ נִתַּנּוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מְלָכֵינוּ כֹהֲנֵינוּ בְּיַד מַלְכֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת בַּחֶרֶב בַּשְּׁבִי וּבַבִּזָּה וּבְבֹשֶׁת פָּנִים כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Now for a brief moment favor has come from YHWH our God, leaving us a remnant and giving us a peg in His holy place, so that our God may brighten our eyes and give us a little reviving in our slavery.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה כִּמְעַט־רֶגַע הָיְתָה תְחִנָּה מֵאֵת יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְהַשְׁאִיר לָנוּ פְּלֵיטָה וְלָתֶת־לָנוּ יָתֵד בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ לְהָאִיר עֵינֵינוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּלְתִתֵּנוּ מִחְיָה מְעַט בְּעַבְדֻתֵנוּ׃

verses.english: For we are slaves, yet in our slavery our God has not forsaken us. He has extended steadfast love to us before the kings of Persia, to give us reviving, to raise up the house of our God and restore its ruins, and to give us a protective wall in Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־עֲבָדִים אֲנַחְנוּ וּבְעַבְדֻתֵנוּ לֹא עֲזָבָנוּ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַיַּט־עָלֵינוּ חֶסֶד לִפְנֵי מַלְכֵי פָרַס לָתֶת־לָנוּ מִחְיָה לְרוֹמֵם אֶת־בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ וּלְהַעֲמִיד אֶת־חָרְבֹתָיו וְלָתֶת־לָנוּ גָדֵר בִּיהוּדָה וּבִירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Now what can we say, our God, after this? For we have forsaken Your commandments,
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־נֹּאמַר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַחֲרֵי־זֹאת כִּי עָזַבְנוּ מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃

verses.english: which You commanded through Your servants the prophets: ‘The land you are entering to possess is a land of impurity through the impurity of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, with which they have filled it from end to end in their uncleanness.
verses.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ בְּיַד עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים לֵאמֹר הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּם בָּאִים לְרִשְׁתָּהּ אֶרֶץ נִדָּה הִיא בְּנִדַּת עַמֵּי הָאֲרָצוֹת בְּתוֹעֲבֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר מִלְאוּהָ מִפֶּה אֶל־פֶּה בְּטֻמְאָתָם׃

verses.english: Now do not give your daughters to their sons, and do not take their daughters for your sons. Never seek their peace or prosperity, so that you may be strong, eat the good of the land and leave it as an inheritance to your sons forever.’
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם אַל־תִּתְּנוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם וּבְנֹתֵיהֶם אַל־תִּשְׂאוּ לִבְנֵיכֶם וְלֹא־תִדְרְשׁוּ שְׁלֹמָם וְטוֹבָתָם עַד־עוֹלָם לְמַעַן תֶּחֶזְקוּ וַאֲכַלְתֶּם אֶת־טוּב הָאָרֶץ וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּם לִבְנֵיכֶם עַד־עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt—for You, our God, have held back below what our iniquities deserved and given us such a remnant—
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵינוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂינוּ הָרָעִים וּבְאַשְׁמָתֵנוּ הַגְּדֹלָה כִּי אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵינוּ חָשַׂכְתָּ לְמַטָּה מֵעֲוֺנֵנוּ וְנָתַתָּה לָּנוּ פְּלֵיטָה כָּזֹאת׃

verses.english: shall we return to breaking Your commandments and intermarrying with the peoples who practice these abominations? Would You not be angry with us until we were consumed, without remnant or survivor?
verses.hebrew: הֲנָשׁוּב לְהָפֵר מִצְוֺתֶיךָ וּלְהִתְחַתֵּן בְּעַמֵּי הַתֹּעֵבוֹת הָאֵלֶּה הֲלוֹא תֶאֱנַף־בָּנוּ עַד־כַּלֵּה לְאֵין שְׁאֵרִית וּפְלֵיטָה׃

verses.english: YHWH, God of Israel, You are righteous, for we have been left as a surviving remnant, as on this day. Here we are before You in our guilt, for because of this no one can stand before You.”
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל צַדִּיק אַתָּה כִּי־נִשְׁאַרְנוּ פְלֵיטָה כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה הִנְנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַשְׁמָתֵינוּ כִּי אֵין לַעֲמוֹד לְפָנֶיךָ עַל־זֹאת׃

verses.english: When Ezra prayed and confessed, weeping and throwing himself down before the house of God, a very great assembly gathered to him from Israel—men, women and children—for the people wept with much weeping.
verses.hebrew: וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּל עֶזְרָא וּכְהִתְוַדֹּתוֹ בֹּכֶה וּמִתְנַפֵּל לִפְנֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים נִקְבְּצוּ אֵלָיו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל קָהָל רַב־מְאֹד אֲנָשִׁים וְנָשִׁים וִילָדִים כִּי־בָכוּ הָעָם הַרְבֵּה־בֶכֶה׃

verses.english: Shecaniah son of Jehiel, of the sons of Elam, answered Ezra, “We have been faithless to our God and have settled foreign wives from the peoples of the land among us. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן שְׁכַנְיָה בֶן־יְחִיאֵל מִבְּנֵי עולם [עֵילָם] וַיֹּאמֶר לְעֶזְרָא אֲנַחְנוּ מָעַלְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵינוּ וַנֹּשֶׁב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וְעַתָּה יֵשׁ־מִקְוֶה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַל־זֹאת׃

verses.english: Now let us make a covenant with our God to send out all the wives and those born from them, by the counsel of the Lord and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God. Let it be done according to the law.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה נִכְרָת־בְּרִית לֵאלֹהֵינוּ לְהוֹצִיא כָל־נָשִׁים וְהַנּוֹלָד מֵהֶם בַּעֲצַת אֲדֹנָי וְהַחֲרֵדִים בְּמִצְוַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָה יֵעָשֶׂה׃

verses.english: Arise, for this matter rests upon you, and we are with you. Be strong and act.”
verses.hebrew: קוּם כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הַדָּבָר וַאֲנַחְנוּ עִמָּךְ חֲזַק וַעֲשֵׂה׃

verses.english: Ezra arose and made the chief priests, the Levites and all Israel swear to act according to this word, and they swore.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא וַיַּשְׁבַּע אֶת־שָׂרֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים הַלְוִיִּם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל לַעֲשׂוֹת כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה וַיִּשָּׁבֵעוּ׃

verses.english: Ezra arose from before the house of God and went to the chamber of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He went there, but ate no bread and drank no water, for he was mourning over the exiles' faithlessness.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא מִלִּפְנֵי בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־לִשְׁכַּת יְהוֹחָנָן בֶּן־אֶלְיָשִׁיב וַיֵּלֶךְ שָׁם לֶחֶם לֹא־אָכַל וּמַיִם לֹא־שָׁתָה כִּי מִתְאַבֵּל עַל־מַעַל הַגּוֹלָה׃

verses.english: They sent a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem to all the sons of the exile, to gather at Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבִירוּ קוֹל בִּיהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלִַם לְכֹל בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה לְהִקָּבֵץ יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: Whoever did not arrive within three days, according to the counsel of the officials and elders, would have all his possessions put under the ban, and he himself would be separated from the assembly of the exiles.
verses.hebrew: וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָבוֹא לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים כַּעֲצַת הַשָּׂרִים וְהַזְּקֵנִים יָחֳרַם כָּל־רְכוּשׁוֹ וְהוּא יִבָּדֵל מִקְּהַל הַגּוֹלָה׃

verses.english: All the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered at Jerusalem within the three days. It was the ninth month, on the twentieth of the month. All the people sat in the open square of the house of God, trembling because of the matter and because of the rains.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּבְצוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־יְהוּדָה וּבִנְיָמִן יְרוּשָׁלִַם לִשְׁלֹשֶׁת הַיָּמִים הוּא חֹדֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁיעִי בְּעֶשְׂרִים בַּחֹדֶשׁ וַיֵּשְׁבוּ כָל־הָעָם בִּרְחוֹב בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים מַרְעִידִים עַל־הַדָּבָר וּמֵהַגְּשָׁמִים׃

verses.english: Ezra the priest arose and said to them, “You have been faithless and have settled foreign wives among you, adding to Israel's guilt.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם אַתֶּם מְעַלְתֶּם וַתֹּשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת לְהוֹסִיף עַל־אַשְׁמַת יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Now give confession to YHWH, the God of your fathers, and do His will. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign wives.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה תְּנוּ תוֹדָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי־אֲבֹתֵיכֶם וַעֲשׂוּ רְצוֹנוֹ וְהִבָּדְלוּ מֵעַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ וּמִן־הַנָּשִׁים הַנָּכְרִיּוֹת׃

verses.english: The whole assembly answered in a loud voice, “Yes! It is upon us to act according to your words.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעְנוּ כָל־הַקָּהָל וַיֹּאמְרוּ קוֹל גָּדוֹל כֵּן כדבריך [כִּדְבָרְךָ] עָלֵינוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת׃

verses.english: But the people are many, and it is the season of rains. We have no strength to stand outside, and the work is not for one day or two, for we have greatly transgressed in this matter.
verses.hebrew: אֲבָל הָעָם רָב וְהָעֵת גְּשָׁמִים וְאֵין כֹּחַ לַעֲמוֹד בַּחוּץ וְהַמְּלָאכָה לֹא־לְיוֹם אֶחָד וְלֹא לִשְׁנַיִם כִּי־הִרְבִּינוּ לִפְשֹׁעַ בַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Let our officials stand for the whole assembly. Let everyone in our cities who has settled foreign wives come at appointed times, with the elders of each city and its judges, until the burning anger of our God is turned away from us concerning this matter.”
verses.hebrew: יַעֲמְדוּ־נָא שָׂרֵינוּ לְכָל־הַקָּהָל וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר בֶּעָרֵינוּ הַהֹשִׁיב נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת יָבֹא לְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים וְעִמָּהֶם זִקְנֵי־עִיר וָעִיר וְשֹׁפְטֶיהָ עַד לְהָשִׁיב חֲרוֹן אַף־אֱלֹהֵינוּ מִמֶּנּוּ עַד לַדָּבָר הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah stood against this, and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ יוֹנָתָן בֶּן־עֲשָׂהאֵל וְיַחְזְיָה בֶן־תִּקְוָה עָמְדוּ עַל־זֹאת וּמְשֻׁלָּם וְשַׁבְּתַי הַלֵּוִי עֲזָרֻם׃

verses.english: The sons of the exile did so. Ezra the priest and men who were ancestral heads were set apart according to their ancestral houses, all of them by name. They sat on the first day of the tenth month to investigate the matter.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־כֵן בְּנֵי הַגּוֹלָה וַיִּבָּדְלוּ עֶזְרָא הַכֹּהֵן אֲנָשִׁים רָאשֵׁי הָאָבוֹת לְבֵית אֲבֹתָם וְכֻלָּם בְּשֵׁמוֹת וַיֵּשְׁבוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי לְדַרְיוֹשׁ הַדָּבָר׃

verses.english: They finished with all the men who had settled foreign wives by the first day of the first month.
verses.hebrew: וַיְכַלּוּ בַכֹּל אֲנָשִׁים הַהֹשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת עַד יוֹם אֶחָד לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

verses.english: Among the sons of the priests who had settled foreign wives were found, from the sons of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib and Gedaliah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמָּצֵא מִבְּנֵי הַכֹּהֲנִים אֲשֶׁר הֹשִׁיבוּ נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת מִבְּנֵי יֵשׁוּעַ בֶּן־יוֹצָדָק וְאֶחָיו מַעֲשֵׂיָה וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר וְיָרִיב וּגְדַלְיָה׃

verses.english: They gave their hand in pledge to send out their wives and, being guilty, offered a ram of the flock for their guilt.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ יָדָם לְהוֹצִיא נְשֵׁיהֶם וַאֲשֵׁמִים אֵיל־צֹאן עַל־אַשְׁמָתָם׃

verses.english: From the sons of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי אִמֵּר חֲנָנִי וּזְבַדְיָה׃

verses.english: From the sons of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel and Uzziah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי חָרִם מַעֲשֵׂיָה וְאֵלִיָּה וּשְׁמַעְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעֻזִיָּה׃

verses.english: From the sons of Pashhur: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad and Elasah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּשְׁחוּר אֶלְיוֹעֵינַי מַעֲשֵׂיָה יִשְׁמָעֵאל נְתַנְאֵל יוֹזָבָד וְאֶלְעָשָׂה׃

verses.english: From the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah—he is Kelita—Pethahiah, Judah and Eliezer.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַלְוִיִּם יוֹזָבָד וְשִׁמְעִי וְקֵלָיָה הוּא קְלִיטָא פְּתַחְיָה יְהוּדָה וֶאֱלִיעֶזֶר׃

verses.english: From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem and Uri.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַמְשֹׁרְרִים אֶלְיָשִׁיב וּמִן־הַשֹּׁעֲרִים שַׁלֻּם וָטֶלֶם וְאוּרִי׃

verses.english: From Israel, from the sons of Parosh: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah and Benaiah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִיִּשְׂרָאֵל מִבְּנֵי פַרְעֹשׁ רַמְיָה וְיִזִּיָּה וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּמִיָּמִן וְאֶלְעָזָר וּמַלְכִּיָּה וּבְנָיָה׃

verses.english: From the sons of Elam: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth and Elijah.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי עֵילָם מַתַּנְיָה זְכַרְיָה וִיחִיאֵל וְעַבְדִּי וִירֵמוֹת וְאֵלִיָּה׃

verses.english: From the sons of Zattu: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad and Aziza.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי זַתּוּא אֶלְיוֹעֵנַי אֶלְיָשִׁיב מַתַּנְיָה וִירֵמוֹת וְזָבָד וַעֲזִיזָא׃

verses.english: From the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai and Athlai.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בֵּבָי יְהוֹחָנָן חֲנַנְיָה זַבַּי עַתְלָי׃

verses.english: From the sons of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal and Jeramoth.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי בָּנִי מְשֻׁלָּם מַלּוּךְ וַעֲדָיָה יָשׁוּב וּשְׁאָל ירמות [וְרָמוֹת׃]

verses.english: From the sons of Pahath-moab: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui and Manasseh.
verses.hebrew: וּמִבְּנֵי פַּחַת מוֹאָב עַדְנָא וּכְלָל בְּנָיָה מַעֲשֵׂיָה מַתַּנְיָה בְצַלְאֵל וּבִנּוּי וּמְנַשֶּׁה׃

verses.english: From the sons of Harim: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Simeon,
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי חָרִם אֱלִיעֶזֶר יִשִּׁיָּה מַלְכִּיָּה שְׁמַעְיָה שִׁמְעוֹן׃

verses.english: Benjamin, Malluch and Shemariah.
verses.hebrew: בְּנְיָמִן מַלּוּךְ שְׁמַרְיָה׃

verses.english: From the sons of Hashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh and Shimei.
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי חָשֻׁם מַתְּנַי מַתַּתָּה זָבָד אֱלִיפֶלֶט יְרֵמַי מְנַשֶּׁה שִׁמְעִי׃

verses.english: From the sons of Bani: Maadai, Amram and Uel;
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי בָנִי מַעֲדַי עַמְרָם וְאוּאֵל׃

verses.english: Benaiah, Bedeiah and Cheluhi;
verses.hebrew: בְּנָיָה בֵדְיָה כלהי [כְּלוּהוּ׃]

verses.english: Vaniah, Meremoth and Eliashib;
verses.hebrew: וַנְיָה מְרֵמוֹת אֶלְיָשִׁיב׃

verses.english: Mattaniah, Mattenai and Jaasau;
verses.hebrew: מַתַּנְיָה מַתְּנַי ויעשו [וְיַעֲשָׂי׃]

verses.english: Bani, Binnui and Shimei;
verses.hebrew: וּבָנִי וּבִנּוּי שִׁמְעִי׃

verses.english: Shelemiah, Nathan and Adaiah;
verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁלֶמְיָה וְנָתָן וַעֲדָיָה׃

verses.english: Machnadebai, Shashai and Sharai;
verses.hebrew: מַכְנַדְבַי שָׁשַׁי שָׁרָי׃

verses.english: Azarel, Shelemiahu and Shemariah;
verses.hebrew: עֲזַרְאֵל וְשֶׁלֶמְיָהוּ שְׁמַרְיָה׃

verses.english: Shallum, Amariah and Joseph.
verses.hebrew: שַׁלּוּם אֲמַרְיָה יוֹסֵף׃

verses.english: From the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddau, Joel and Benaiah.
verses.hebrew: מִבְּנֵי נְבוֹ יְעִיאֵל מַתִּתְיָה זָבָד זְבִינָא ידו [יַדַּי] וְיוֹאֵל בְּנָיָה׃

verses.english: All these had taken foreign wives; and among them were wives, and they placed sons.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־אֵלֶּה נשאי [נָשְׂאוּ] נָשִׁים נָכְרִיּוֹת וְיֵשׁ מֵהֶם נָשִׁים וַיָּשִׂימוּ בָּנִים׃
